Relatório de Lixo Marinho

A report made to authorities or VTS regarding observed floating or drifting marine debris that may pose a hazard to navigation.

What is Relatório de Lixo Marinho?

In this glossary, Relatório de Lixo Marinho refers to: A report made to authorities or VTS regarding observed floating or drifting marine debris that may pose a hazard to navigation.

How is Relatório de Lixo Marinho used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Embarcação para VTS: Relatório de Lixo Marinho – detritos grandes avistados à deriva próximo à marca 7."

Relatório de Lixo Marinho matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Definition

A report made to authorities or VTS regarding observed floating or drifting marine debris that may pose a hazard to navigation.

Operational example

Vessel to VTS: Marine Litter Report – large debris observed drifting near channel marker 7.

Localized term

Relatório de Lixo Marinho

Localized example

Embarcação para VTS: Relatório de Lixo Marinho – detritos grandes avistados à deriva próximo à marca 7.
